**predictalot 1.1.2**

- Added a security notice: all data sent via predictalot (time series, feature values, model IDs) leaves your host and is transmitted to the configured service; users should only connect to instances they run or explicitly trust.
- Minor documentation changes in SKILL.md to reflect the new data transmission warning.

predictalot 1.1.0

- Added a new "Security & safety" section to documentation, highlighting authentication, safe network exposure, and destructive delete safeguards.
- Clarified that the skill is "consumer-only" and never starts, provisions, or hardens the backend server.
- Added warnings about exposure of the HTTP port and best practices for operator security (binding, token management).
- Made explicit that destructive model deletions require user confirmation and must use recently-obtained model IDs.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

- Expanded and clarified documentation in SKILL.md, detailing all available time-series and tabular forecasting/model endpoints, supported models, types, and usage scenarios.
- Added a comprehensive quick start guide with example curl requests for health checks and predictions.
- Specified authentication options, including bearer token or optional open access.
- Provided tables for supported time-series model types and tabular ML backends, including licensing notes and recommended use cases.
- Outlined clear guidance on when the skill should and should not be used, along with explicit setup instructions.
